# Bristol - council briefing

*Auto-generated from council minutes, 2026-06-15 to 2026-08-13*

## What's dominating the agenda

Transport & Highways appears across 6327 document references, primarily via the Transport & Connectivity Policy Committee. Housing & Planning ranks second at 4429 references. The pattern reflects Bristol's ongoing management of surface transport, housing supply, and capital expenditure planning.

## Notable decisions

- Education spending powers first authorised in October 2025 were exercised by the Director of Education, under delegation from the Children and Young People Policy Committee (6 Aug).
- Housing Investment Plan 25/26 spending was delegated to the Executive Director of Growth, following February 2025 full-council approval (3 Aug, approved).
- The council responded to a proposed sale of shares in Bristol Heat Networks Ltd, in which it holds a special share with change-of-control rights (30 Jul, approved).
- The One City Clean Rivers Action Plan was approved (30 Jul).
- The outline BNET (Bristol Network) Business Plan was presented to committee (27 Jul, approved).
- The High Streets Strategy Task and Finish Group's closure report and future approach were approved (27 Jul).

## Worth a closer look

- A Community Climate proposal package at Environment and Sustainability Policy Committee - committee report plus environmental and equality impact assessments, unusually climate-concentrated for this period: [report](https://councilgateway.poteris.co.uk/council-api/documents/1547935/file), [EIA](https://councilgateway.poteris.co.uk/council-api/documents/1547941/file), [EqIA](https://councilgateway.poteris.co.uk/council-api/documents/1547939/file)

## Projects on residents' radar

- **East Bristol Liveable Neighbourhood** - the council approved making this traffic scheme permanent and submitting a Full Business Case for CRSTS funding to complete it (9 Jul). [source](https://democracy.bristol.gov.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=3278)
- **Bristol Regional Cycling Hub** - committee approved submitting the Full Business Case to the West of England Mayoral Combined Authority and starting early works ahead of full construction (9 Jul). [source](https://democracy.bristol.gov.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=3280)
- **Workplace Parking Levy** - the council approved a draft Outline Business Case and investment strategy for the proposed levy, ahead of public consultation (9 Jul). [source](https://democracy.bristol.gov.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=3279)
- **Temple Island** - committee approved deploying the remaining £32m Economic Development Fund into site-wide infrastructure and varied the site's Agreement for Lease to support delivery (13 Jul). [source](https://democracy.bristol.gov.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=3295)
- **Pride in Place programme, Hartcliffe** - the council approved accepting up to £20m of government funding over 10 years for the Hartcliffe programme (26 May). [source](https://democracy.bristol.gov.uk/ieDecisionDetails.aspx?ID=3207)
